dedupe_keys.name: half degree gridded nitrogen and phosphorus fertilizer use for global agriculture 1900 2013

description: This dataset gives annual synthetic nitrogen and phosphorus fertilizer use rates on cropland at 0.5 degree resolution from 1900 to 2013, matched to the HYDE 3.2 historical land use maps. The PANGAEA record says it was built because Earth system and land surface models lacked spatial fertilizer input data, draws on IFA and FAO country surveys available from 1961, and shows N and P use rates rising about eight and three times since 1961, with hotspots moving from the US and Western Europe to East Asia. It was published in 2016 by Chaoqun Lu and Hanqin Tian as a downloadable ZIP of about 8.3 MB, free under CC BY 3.0, with global coverage. Caveats: values before 1961 rest on extrapolation, and rates are per cropland area, not per crop. For simulation it supplies long nutrient input histories for crop yield, water quality and emissions models, and a baseline for fertilizer supply shock scenarios. Related catalogue records include the global NH4+ and NO3- synthetic nitrogen fertilizer map and the UKCEH Land Cover plus Fertilisers for England.
name: Half-degree gridded nitrogen and phosphorus fertilizer use for global agriculture, 1900-2013
provider: Chaoqun Lu and Hanqin Tian, via PANGAEA
